title: Have a Meeting & Have Time
situation: A short team meeting before the shift starts.
objective: Use have a meeting and have time to talk about schedules at work.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Every morning, we have a short meeting with the supervisor.
dialogue.indonesian: Setiap pagi, kami mengadakan rapat singkat dengan supervisor.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: In the meeting, we talk about the schedule and the machines for today.
dialogue.indonesian: Dalam rapat, kami membahas jadwal dan mesin untuk hari ini.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Sometimes I do not have time to finish my coffee before the meeting.
dialogue.indonesian: Terkadang saya tidak punya waktu untuk menghabiskan kopi sebelum rapat.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: If we have time, we check the machine together after the meeting.
dialogue.indonesian: Jika punya waktu, kami memeriksa mesin bersama setelah rapat.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: When the day is very busy, we do not have time for a long meeting.
dialogue.indonesian: Ketika hari sangat sibuk, kami tidak punya waktu untuk rapat panjang.

learningNotes: have a meeting memakai a karena meeting adalah benda yang bisa dihitung.
have time tidak memakai a: have time, bukan have a time.
Bentuk negatifnya: I do not have time, atau I don't have time.
